owner_creation.analysis: FILE:src/cvt.rs: cvt_alloc_chpos returns a newly ecalloc-owned integer map; cvt_text borrows caller source, destination, optional map and length, and temporarily owns an ANSI parser state.
owner_creation.invariant: Returned maps and caller buffers have different owners.
limitations: Source inspection under M0-MEM-001 only; current call sites and character encoders need their separate full owner/range reviews.

aliases_escapes.analysis: FILE:src/cvt.rs: Source/destination/map cursors are raw interior aliases; no slice length proves that caller-provided output or map storage covers all writes.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Conversion requires independently valid buffer extents.
limitations: Source inspection under M0-MEM-001 only; current call sites and character encoders need their separate full owner/range reviews.

callback_targets.analysis: FILE:src/cvt.rs: step_charc, put_wchar, ansi_start/step/done and ctype operations are direct calls; no callback context is retained beyond conversion.
callback_targets.invariant: Parser-state lifetime ends at its matching ansi_done.
limitations: Source inspection under M0-MEM-001 only; current call sites and character encoders need their separate full owner/range reviews.

invalidation.analysis: FILE:src/cvt.rs: Backspace and CR operations move cursors inside retained output; external replacement of source or map while conversion runs would invalidate those aliases.
invalidation.invariant: Conversion borrows must remain stable through the call.
limitations: Source inspection under M0-MEM-001 only; current call sites and character encoders need their separate full owner/range reviews.

mutation_commit.analysis: FILE:src/cvt.rs: cvt_length uses wrapping multiply/add and writes output incrementally; allocation sizing and final lenp assignment do not establish a checked all-or-nothing commit.
mutation_commit.invariant: Wrapped sizing cannot prove destination capacity.
limitations: Source inspection under M0-MEM-001 only; current call sites and character encoders need their separate full owner/range reviews.

release_pair.analysis: FILE:src/cvt.rs: Caller must free the chpos map with the matching allocator; each nonnull ansi_start branch calls ansi_done, while cvt_text must never free borrowed osrc/odst.
release_pair.invariant: Temporary parser state and returned maps release separately.
limitations: Source inspection under M0-MEM-001 only; current call sites and character encoders need their separate full owner/range reviews.

error_cleanup.analysis: FILE:src/cvt.rs: There is no typed capacity error or rollback after partial output; ecalloc failure exits through pager cleanup, and wide src_pos narrows into c_int map entries.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure and narrowing remain explicit raw-core risks.
limitations: Source inspection under M0-MEM-001 only; current call sites and character encoders need their separate full owner/range reviews.

signals_handoff.analysis: FILE:src/cvt.rs: utf_mode is a shared translated global and the conversion uses raw cursor state; no signal callback is installed here or allowed to replace active buffers.
signals_handoff.invariant: Caller-controlled conversion is not asynchronous owner-safe.
limitations: Source inspection under M0-MEM-001 only; current call sites and character encoders need their separate full owner/range reviews.
